title: CPI Inflation Crushes Markets
speaker: Matt (Trade Brigade)

macro_themes.view: CPI came in hotter than forecast with shelter rising, which is sticky, so he thinks the Fed should hike now and markets mispricing an October pause.
Leadership rotated into defensives (staples, energy, healthcare) while semis, memory and software sold off, which is not enough to support the index.
He would prefer a sharp washout low to the current grinding action before buying.
